title: UserUnderstanding
description: Output of UserUnderstandingAgent: per-interest TAGS (expertise, understanding state, intent, cross potential, sensitive category). The agent does not echo the profile's own fields (Interest/Keywords/Weight) — code re-attaches the tags to the verbatim profile interests afterwards. Each tag entry's Name must match the profile interest it tags.

Interests.description: One tag entry per profile interest. Tag every interest — drop none.

Name.description: The profile interest's name, copied verbatim so code can re-attach the tags.

Intent.description: One or more intents the user has for THIS interest — a user can want several things at once (e.g. track the latest AND deepen skill). List every intent that genuinely applies; do not pad. At least one.

Description.description: A grounded 1-2 sentence description of what the user is focused on in THIS interest and why — the natural-language expansion of this interest's Expertise + UnderstandingState + Intent. Written so a downstream reader understands the user's real angle on this interest without needing the enum definitions.

aiRelated.description: True if the interest is fundamentally about AI / machine learning / LLMs / generative-AI tools or the AI industry.

SensitiveCategory.description: Empty unless the interest falls in a blocked sensitive category.

targetTag.description: Tags for the caller's target interest, produced AFTER all profile interests are tagged. The target is not one of the user's profile interests; its tag is derived by copying from the closest profile interest and judging its civic scope.

Name.description: The target interest name, copied verbatim from target_interest_names.

closestInterestName.description: Name of the profile interest most semantically related to the target, whose tags were copied. Empty string if no profile interest is reasonably related.

Intent.description: Intents for the target, copied from the closest profile interest (or a conservative default if none is related).

angleScope.description: The angle to approach the target from. personal_life = the user as a hands-on participant/enthusiast in their own everyday life (owning/doing/enjoying/choosing it). macro_observer = a detached, big-picture spectator angle (industry/market/investment/policy/business-strategy/academic analysis). Prefer personal_life whenever the target plausibly admits a personal-life angle — only pick macro_observer when the user's interest is genuinely in the macro/analytical view itself.

Description.description: A grounded 1-2 sentence description of what the user wants from the target and at what depth — the natural-language expansion of Expertise + UnderstandingState + Intent. MUST also state the angleScope stance in words (personal everyday participant angle vs macro/observer angle).

aiRelated.description: True if the target interest is fundamentally about AI / machine learning / LLMs / generative-AI tools or the AI industry. Same test as per-interest aiRelated.
